sloka: जल आर्द्राः चक्रवाकाः च निष्पतन्ति स्म सर्वशः ।नूनम् सलिलवान् अत्र कूपो वा यदि वा ह्रदः ॥४-५०-१६॥
transliteration: jala ārdrāḥ cakravākāḥ ca niṣpatanti sma sarvaśaḥ ।nūnam salilavān atra kūpo vā yadi vā hradaḥ ॥4-50-16॥

translations.english: 'From this cave have emerged several birds like sarasas, swans, kraunchas and chakravakas drenched in water. Surely there must be a source of plenty of water or well or a pond. Moreover there are shining( green) trees at the entrance of the cave (suggesting subsoil water).'
